query: Who is the writer of this song that was inspired by words on a tombstone and was the first track on the box set Back to Mono?

repl_history.response:
The Global Context Preview contains information about the box set "Back to Mono (1958–1969)". After scanning the text, I see that the first track on this box set is "To Know Him Is to Love Him" and it features Phil Spector performing as part of the group the Teddy Bears.

FINAL ANSWER: Phil Spector
